outer_silhouette.method: Alpha > 128, largest connected component of reference, both canvases unchanged. Visible edge wear contributes to differences. This does not assess internal artwork.

lettering.method: Rendered final SVG lettering compared with measured reference ink/cream masks on the identity grid. IoU is shape agreement for these regions, not a whole-design fidelity score.

limitations: Photographic colour variation, paper grain and rough edge fringe intentionally replaced by flat colour and smooth geometry.
Custom geometric type and saved font outlines visually reconstruct lettering; exact historical fonts were not recovered.
Small contour/weight differences remain, especially lower route lettering and a few upper glyphs.
Dogwood internal seams and tiny radial marks are visually reconstructed.
Ferry geometry hidden by the gull is inferred only to continue the editable shapes coherently.
